description: Compiles the PLC and returns the message tree + a verification summary (Gd8: only ERROR blocks, warnings don't) and nextHints. This is the offline VERIFIER: a clean compile is a precondition (Gd9) for download/S7. Maps to POST /plcs/{plc}/compile. M-off. Long operation: may answer status:"running" + jobId — then call tia_job_status.
name: tia_compile
title: TIA — compile (verifier)
